entryPointReview: The real exported pickup_object path ran lift_object, pick_obj, addinv, and pickup_prinv on an initialized game and then awaited fix_ghostly_obj on the actual returned object. The source-generated BOW had no matching inventory stack; identity and floor removal were checked. The same test also exercised left-handed naming, marked ordinary silent clearing, and unmarked quiet behavior. Runtime receipts are focused constructed-state evidence only; no saved bones level, public history, or C certification is claimed.
